Container.Name: cabinet-linkup
Container.Overview: The self-run server behind LinkUp on CabinetOS: friends, invites and an optional relay. Forward the console port on your router. Never forward the admin port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything the server keeps. Back up this folder. Make it before the first start, owned by 99:100, or the server stops with "the data folder cannot be written". In Unraid's terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/cabinet-linkup && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/cabinet-linkup

Config.Name: Console port
Config.Description: Forward this one on your router.

Config.Name: Admin port
Config.Description: The admin page. Never forward this one.

Config.Name: Relay ports
Config.Description: The relay, and its games' ports after it, for up to 16 games at once. Forward only if you turn the relay on, and only as far as its Relay tab says. Keep the same numbers on both sides: the relay tells consoles its own ports.
